findings.title: Hardcoded default administrator credentials in firmware image
findings.evidence: Found credential strings in firmware binary wr001_sample_firmware.bin: Default configuration: username=admin password=admin pcPassword=admin
findings.impact: Static strings embedded inside firmware binaries expose default credentials, facilitating unauthorized administrative access across all identical devices.
findings.recommendation: Remove all embedded plaintext default credentials and enforce unique per-device initialization keys.

findings.title: Embedded Telnet daemon (telnetd) present in firmware
findings.evidence: Found telnetd references and binaries embedded inside firmware wr001_sample_firmware.bin.
findings.impact: The inclusion of telnetd enables unencrypted command-line management on exposed network ports.
findings.recommendation: Remove telnetd from production firmware builds or disable its daemon startup by default.

findings.title: Firmware package lacks cryptographic signature verification
findings.evidence: Firmware image wr001_sample_firmware.bin lacks cryptographic signature headers or verification manifests.
findings.impact: Without cryptographic signatures, devices cannot verify the authenticity of firmware updates, leaving them susceptible to malicious firmware modification.
findings.recommendation: Implement cryptographic signing (e.g. RSA-PSS or Ed25519) on all firmware upgrade packages and verify signatures before flashing.
